title: Cockpit preparation — panel scan
scope: Recall the six areas in the printed flow pattern. Each area contains further actions in SOP-06; this is a panel-order drill.

steps.label: Overhead panel
steps.target: Complete the overhead scan and its conditional checks.

steps.label: Centre instrument panel
steps.target: Continue through the centre instrument panel.

steps.label: Pedestal
steps.target: Continue through the pedestal.

steps.label: FMGS preparation
steps.target: Prepare and crosscheck applicable flight data.

steps.label: Glareshield
steps.target: Each pilot completes their own-side checks.

steps.label: Lateral consoles and instrument panels
steps.target: Each pilot completes their own-side checks.

title: Automatic engine start — selected actions
scope: Selected physical actions and observed gates in SOP-08, after start clearance and ground prerequisites. Communications are omitted. Monitor the full start sequence on the source pages.

steps.label: Thrust levers
steps.target: IDLE

steps.label: Engine mode selector
steps.target: IGN/START

steps.label: Engine 1 display readiness
steps.target: Wait until amber crosses, except N1/N2, and messages disappear before selecting the master.

steps.label: Engine 1 master
steps.target: ON; monitor the start sequence and idle parameters in the source.

steps.label: Engine 2
steps.target: Apply the engine 2 start and monitoring sequence in SOP-08.

title: After start — PF
scope: Both engines started; two-engine taxi departure. Conditional selections remain conditional. This drill omits communications and is followed by the crew checklist.

steps.label: Engine mode selector
steps.target: NORM

steps.label: APU bleed
steps.target: OFF

steps.label: Engine anti-ice
steps.target: AS REQUIRED; ON when icing exists or is anticipated on the ground.

steps.label: Wing anti-ice
steps.target: AS REQUIRED

steps.label: APU master
steps.target: OFF if APU is not required.

steps.label: ECAM status
steps.target: Check and crosscheck; if STS appears, display the STATUS page.

steps.label: N/W steering disconnect memo
steps.target: Check NOT DISPLAYED.

steps.label: Thrust setting
steps.target: Crosscheck E/WD thrust setting against FMS PERF.

title: After start — PM
scope: Selected two-engine taxi actions. Keep flaps retracted to the holding point when taxiing in icing conditions with rain, slush or snow.

steps.label: Ground spoilers
steps.target: ARM

steps.label: Rudder trim reset
steps.target: PRESS

steps.label: Rudder trim
steps.target: CHECK NEUTRAL; up to 0.3° L/R may be indicated after reset.

steps.label: Flaps lever
steps.target: SET FOR TAKEOFF, subject to the icing/taxi condition.

steps.label: Flap position
steps.target: CHECK on the upper ECAM display.

steps.label: Pitch trim wheel
steps.target: SET takeoff CG.

steps.label: ECAM status
steps.target: CHECK; PF crosschecks.

title: After takeoff — PM
scope: Selected SOP-13 actions. Use the source conditions when the APU supplied the packs, TA-only was used, or icing is present.

steps.label: APU bleed
steps.target: OFF if the APU supplied air conditioning for takeoff.

steps.label: APU master
steps.target: OFF if the APU supplied air conditioning for takeoff.

steps.label: Engine mode selector
steps.target: AS REQUIRED; IGN/START for severe turbulence or heavy rain.

steps.label: TCAS
steps.target: TA/RA or TFC if takeoff was performed in TA-only.

steps.label: Engine anti-ice
steps.target: AS REQUIRED under the source icing conditions and SAT exception.

steps.label: Wing anti-ice
steps.target: AS REQUIRED; observe the evidence-of-ice criteria in the source.

title: After landing — PF
scope: Begin after vacating the runway. This is the PF control subset, not the complete after-landing procedure.

steps.label: Ground spoilers
steps.target: DISARM after runway vacated.

steps.label: Landing lights
steps.target: RETRACT

steps.label: Strobe lights
steps.target: AUTO when leaving the runway; ON when crossing a runway.

steps.label: Nose light
steps.target: TAXI when leaving the runway.

steps.label: Other exterior lights
steps.target: AS REQUIRED

title: Parking — PF selected actions
scope: Parking sequence including brake, electrical-supply and cooling conditions. Read the complete parking procedure; PM actions run alongside this subset.

steps.label: Accumulator pressure
steps.target: CHECK green band. If low, chocks are required before engine 1 shutdown.

steps.label: Parking brake
steps.target: ON; avoid applying above 500°C, or above 350°C with brake fans ON, unless operationally necessary.

steps.label: Brake pressure
steps.target: CHECK; hold pedals until both needles are above the green area.

steps.label: Yellow electric pump
steps.target: OFF before engine 1 shutdown when used for one-engine taxi.

steps.label: Electrical supply
steps.target: If no APU: EXT PWR AVAIL then ON. If APU used: check APU AVAIL.

steps.label: Engine masters
steps.target: OFF no less than 3 min after high-thrust operations.

steps.label: Engine parameters
steps.target: CHECK decreasing.

steps.label: Wing lights
steps.target: OFF

steps.label: Beacon
steps.target: OFF when all engines are below approximately 20% N2.

steps.label: Other exterior lights
steps.target: AS REQUIRED

title: Securing — CM2
scope: Selected physical actions in SOP-23. Apply company policy and relevant adverse-weather procedures first. CM1 checks the parking brake and switches ADIRS off; allow at least 10 s after ADIRS shutdown before electrical power off.

steps.label: Crew oxygen supply
steps.target: OFF

steps.label: Exterior lights
steps.target: OFF

steps.label: Maintenance bus
steps.target: AS REQUIRED for crew or servicing personnel.

steps.label: APU bleed
steps.target: OFF

steps.label: External power
steps.target: AS REQUIRED

steps.label: APU master
steps.target: OFF after all occupants disembark.

steps.label: Emergency exit lights and signs
steps.target: OFF

steps.label: Batteries 1 and 2
steps.target: OFF only after APU flap fully closed, about 2 min after APU AVAIL goes out.
